name: 27157 · Winston Salem, NC
findings: ZIP 27157 (Winston Salem) has 18 nonprofit organizations. 11 of them (61%) list at least one way to get involved in their tax returns or on their websites: membership, volunteering, public events, or civic and political action.
The most common is membership, listed by 11 organizations.
100% of the organizations offering opportunities have no identified type, so the breakdown by type is partial.

observations.title: Too few organizations for firm comparisons
observations.text: ZIP 27157 (Winston Salem) has 11 organizations listing opportunities in their tax returns or websites, too few to compare reliably with similar places. Civic life here may run through churches, schools, local government, or informal groups that these records don't capture.

confidence.text: Based on 18 organizations here; 100% of all organizations here have no identified type.
